results.title: Edit your Business Profile - Google Business Profile Help
results.markdown:
Title: Edit your Business Profile - Google Business Profile Help

URL Source: https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617

Markdown Content:
You can edit your verified Business Profile on Google to keep your business info accurate and up to date. You can update details like your address, hours, contact info, and photos to help customers find and learn more about your business.

[Manage your business](https://business.google.com/?skipLandingPage=true&gmbsrc=ww-ww-et-gs-z-gmb-v-z-h~bhc-core-u|mybb)

**Important****:**

*   To show your business on Search, Maps, and other Google services, you must [add or claim your business](https://support.google.com/business/answer/2911778) then [verify your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7107242).
*   Some businesses might need to verify their Business Profile first before they can make any changes with their info.

## Edit a Business Profile

You can edit your Business Profile directly on Search or Maps. Certain features to manage your profile may differ between Search and Maps and your device's operating system.

**Important:** To edit your business info, you need to sign in to the Google Account that's linked to your Business Profile.

### [](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617)Edit your Business Profile on Google Search

1.   [Go to your Business Profile](https://business.google.com/).
2.   Select **Edit profile**.
3.   After you make your changes, select **Save**.

### Edit your Business Profile with the Google Maps app

1.   On your mobile device, open the Google Maps app ![Image 1: Maps](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/yBT9NcPCOum61BXUrmlfBecOpNufMGBDbh3rFQfIQu1Rs23tjRnhNdEou6yHAurnyw=h36).
2.   At the bottom right, tap **Business**.
3.   Tap **Edit profile**.
4.   After you make your changes, tap **Save**.

### [](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617)Suggest an edit to someone else's Business Profile

*   If you find something wrong with a Business Profile that you don’t own or manage, you can [suggest an edit](https://support.google.com/maps/answer/7084895).
*   If someone else's business is missing from Google Maps, you can [add a missing place](https://support.google.com/maps/answer/6320846).

## Review information collected by Google

**Important:**This feature is currently available for select regions, languages, and business categories and may not be available for all users.

To confirm your business details and keep your Business Profile updated and discoverable for customers looking for businesses like yours, Google may occasionally reach out using automated messages via call, text, or WhatsApp to the verified phone number on your profile.

Any information you provide in response to these messages may be used to update your profile. [Learn more about automated calls and texts from Google to confirm business info](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7690269).

To review and manage this collected information:

1.   [Go to your Business Profile](https://business.google.com/).
2.   Select **Edit profile**![Image 2: and then](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/LXIVMHxIoJ-ODytEi75yC-dtUFJFsRd6p8dopSSRr_ZUOPKvyuUgsU-7zVNA6ui8LmRz=h36)**Collected info**.
3.   Review the information to confirm its accuracy. 
    *   You can also find the source of this info and the date it was collected.
    *   This information displays in the language it was originally provided in.

4.   If you want to remove a piece of information, select **Delete**![Image 3: and then](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/LXIVMHxIoJ-ODytEi75yC-dtUFJFsRd6p8dopSSRr_ZUOPKvyuUgsU-7zVNA6ui8LmRz=h36)**Delete**. 
    *   **Tip:**Deleting collected information removes it from Google's records but does not change other details already on your Business Profile.

## [](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617)Types of edits

Here are some details and tips for the kind of info you can add or edit on your Business Profile.

[Business name](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617)

Enter your business name exactly as it appears on your real world business signage, stationery, and other branding. If you change your business name after it’s verified, you might need to verify your business again. [Learn more about Business Profile quality guidelines](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177).

[Category](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617)

Select the category that best matches what your business does. All locations of a business must share a “Primary category.” Choose a specific category that represents your main business. If you select several categories, the category in the first field will be your primary category. [Learn more about how to manage your business category](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7249669).

You can select up to 9 more categories. If you have trouble choosing a category for your business, choose one that’s general.

**Tips:**

*   Do not use categories solely as keywords or to describe features of your business.
*   Do not use categories that match other nearby or related businesses.  
**Example:**
    *   A business that’s located inside your business’s physical location
    *   Another business that your business is located inside.

[Address and pin location](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617)

[Service area](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617)

If your business serves customers within a specific local area, enter your service area. When you list your service area, this helps people know if you can visit or deliver to their location.

You can set your service area based on the cities, zip codes, or other places you serve. [Learn about how to set your service area](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9157481).

**Tip:** When you set your service area, be as specific and accurate as possible.

[Hours](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617)

*   To change your hours for holidays or other temporary periods, [set special hours](https://support.google.com/business/answer/6303076#holiday_hours).
*   If you have different hours for different features you offer, [set more hours](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9876800#more_hour).

[Phone number](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617)

In addition to your primary business phone number, you can enter up to 2 more phone numbers. They can be mobile numbers or landline, but not fax.

**Tip:** You can choose to hide your phone number on your Business Profile.

#### Hide your Business Profile phone number

2.   On your Business Profile, select More ![Image 4](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/iEsZGhIiEJCsmv43PCHdRcC7zUaM4qrDkKcTnMLzYw_rUm7mmzl2bR7nQqDrtjGb4I6T=h36)![Image 5: and then](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36)**Business Profile settings**.

results.title: Tips to improve your local ranking on Google
results.markdown:
Title: Tips to improve your local ranking on Google

URL Source: https://support.google.com/business/answer/7091

Markdown Content:
[Manage your business](https://business.google.com/?skipLandingPage=true&gmbsrc=ww-ww-et-gs-z-gmb-v-z-h~bhc-core-u|mybb)

When a customer searches for a business or place near their location, they’ll find local results on Google Maps and Search. For example, a customer might find local places near them if they search for “Italian restaurant” on their phone. Google tries to show customers the kind of nearby business they’d like to visit.

You can use your Business Profile to improve your business’s local ranking. [Learn more about how Google sources business information for search results](https://support.google.com/business/answer/2721884).

[How to improve your local ranking on Google](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WpCeu4ezaeI)

## Verify your business

This tells Google that you’re authorized to represent the business, so it's more likely to show up in search results. [Learn how to verify your business on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7107242).

## [](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7091)Keep your business information up-to-date

Businesses with complete and accurate info are more likely to show up in local search results. If your business info isn’t accurate, your Business Profile might not show up for relevant searches in your area.[Learn how to edit your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617).

Make sure your business info is as complete as possible in your Business Profile. This helps customers know what you do, where you are, and when they can visit. Provide information like:

*   Your full address, if your business has a location that customers can visit. [Learn how to manage your business address](https://support.google.com/business/answer/2853879).
*   Your business hours, including [special store hours](https://support.google.com/business/answer/6303076).[Learn how to edit your hours](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617#hours).
*   What kind of business you are.[Learn how to manage your business category](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7249669).
*   Other details such as parking or Wi-Fi availability. [Learn how to manage your business attributes](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9049526).

## Respond to reviews

When you reply to customer reviews, it shows that you value their feedback. Positive reviews and helpful replies can help your business stand out.

*   [Learn how to manage customer reviews](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3474050).
*   [Learn more tips to get more Google reviews](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7035772).

## Add photos & videos

You can show customers what you offer and tell the story of your business with photos and videos. [Learn how to manage photos or videos for your Business Profiles](https://support.google.com/business/answer/6103862).

## Add in-store products

**Important:** This is available only for retail businesses in eligible countries or regions.

If you have a retail store, you can show your in-store products on your Business Profile. When you do this, your in-store products might show in local search results and customers can find out what’s in stock. [Learn how to showcase in-store products](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9934993).

## [](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7091)Understand factors that determine local ranking

**Important:** There's no way to request or pay for a better local ranking on Google. We do our best to keep the search algorithm details confidential to make the ranking system as fair as possible for everyone.

Local results are mainly based on relevance, distance, and popularity. Together, these factors help Google find the best match for customers’ searches.

### Relevance

Relevance is how well a Business Profile matches what someone is searching for. To help Google better understand your business and match it to relevant searches, provide complete and detailed business info.

### Distance

Distance refers to how far each business is from the customer who’s searching. If a customer doesn’t share where they are, Google uses what it knows about their location.

### Prominence

Prominence means how well-known a business is. Prominent places are more likely to show up in search results. This factor’s also based on info like how many websites link to your business and how many reviews you have. More reviews and positive ratings can help your business’s local ranking.

## Related resources

*   [Manage your business information](https://support.google.com/business/topic/4596687)
*   [Understand your Business Profile performance & insights](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9918094)
